idea:
Add tags to the task list in this package.
- store.add(title, { tags }) accepts an optional array of tags. Tags are trimmed and lower-cased, duplicates are dropped, and every task has a tags array, empty when none were given.
- store.list({ tag }) returns only the tasks that have that tag, matched without regard to case. store.list() still returns every task.
- formatTask in src/format.js appends the tags as " #tag" after the title, for example "[ ] 1 Buy milk #home #errand". A task with no tags prints as before.
- In the CLI (src/cli.js), "add Buy milk --tag home --tag errand" adds a task with those tags, and "list --tag home" lists only that tag. An unknown option throws an Error whose message is "Unknown option: --x", and a --tag with no value throws "--tag needs a value".
Before you finish, someone other than whoever wrote the change must review it, and their written findings go in REVIEW.md.

milestones.title: Implement tag support in store, formatter and CLI
milestones.plan:
# Tags in the task list: implementation

Touch only src/store.js, src/format.js, src/cli.js and tests under test/. Keep existing behaviour for untagged tasks.

## store.js
- add(title, { tags } = {}) normalizes each tag with String(tag).trim().toLowerCase(), drops duplicates keeping first-seen order, and always returns a task with a tags array (empty when omitted).
- list(options = {}) filters by options.tag with the same trim/lower-case comparison; list() still returns every task.
- complete() preserves tags.

## format.js
- formatTask appends one [space + # + tag] per tag after the title, e.g. [ ] 1 Buy milk #home #errand. A task with no tags prints exactly as before.

## cli.js
- Parse argv for add/list: positional words form the title for add; --tag may repeat and consumes the next token as its value.
- add Buy milk --tag home --tag errand adds with those tags; list --tag home filters.
- Any other --option throws Error(Unknown option: --x) using the literal option token.
- --tag with no following value (or followed by another option) throws Error(--tag needs a value).

## Tests
Add test/tags.test.js covering: tag normalization, duplicate removal, default empty tags array, case-insensitive list filtering, list() returning all, formatTask with and without tags, CLI add and list with tags, and both error messages exactly. Run: node --test

## Acceptance
- node --test passes.
- A read of the three source files matches criteria c1-c4 in the working interpretation.

# Independent review

A reviewer who did not write the change inspects the delivered files in the project folder, runs the test suite, and writes REVIEW.md with written findings.

## What to check
- src/store.js: add(title, { tags }) trims and lower-cases tags, drops duplicates, always gives every task a tags array (empty when omitted); list({ tag }) filters case-insensitively; list() returns every task.
- src/format.js: tags render as one [space + # + tag] after the title; untagged tasks print as before.
- src/cli.js: repeatable --tag on add, --tag on list, unknown option throws Error(Unknown option: --x) with the literal token, valueless --tag throws Error(--tag needs a value).
- Tests cover the above and node --test passes.

## Output
REVIEW.md with: what was checked, each finding with file/line where possible, any defect or gap, and an explicit verdict (approve or changes needed). Do not modify src/ or test/; a review finding is written, not fixed.

## Acceptance
- REVIEW.md exists and contains written findings and a verdict from a reviewer other than the implementer.
- The reviewer ran node --test in the project folder and reported the result.
